baseline.equivalence_test: all four arms receive identical one-shot Top-50 candidates, embeddings, and Answer Scorer values

core_invariants: Freeze nq_open validation[3150:3200], all 50 positions, Wiki-DPR retrieval, Answer Scorer, Generator, evaluator, and answer labels.
Retrieve exactly once and score exactly once per question; fan out the same Top-50 to all selector arms.
Selector inputs contain only question and ordinary Top-50 fields; no gold, panel, generation, or evaluator output reaches selection.
Preserve each selected Top-5 order when calling the frozen Generator.
Complete question/passage/prediction records remain exchange-only; compact summary, metadata, hashes, and provenance are safe for GitHub.

interfaces.input_schema: 50 fixed NQ-Open questions and Wiki-DPR index
interfaces.output_schema: one shared Top-50 list with id, title, text, rank, retrieval score, embedding, and Answer Scorer score

interfaces.input_schema: shared query embedding, Top-50 embeddings/texts/metadata, and scorer values
interfaces.output_schema: four ordered unique Top-5 records plus support trace for the graph arm and explicit null-control identity

interfaces.input_schema: question and one selector's ordered Top-5 context
interfaces.output_schema: prediction, EM/F1, proxy evidence flags, and elapsed time

interfaces.input_schema: complete case records and runtime provenance

plugins.insertion_point: after query encoding and before selector calls
plugins.hypothesis: A shared candidate pool makes the selector comparison causal at the Top-50 to Top-5 boundary.
plugins.input_schema: 50 fixed NQ-Open questions and Wiki-DPR index
plugins.output_schema: one shared Top-50 list with id, title, text, rank, retrieval score, embedding, and Answer Scorer score
plugins.resource_estimate: one Wiki-DPR query and one Answer Scorer pass per question
failure_signatures: scorer call count not equal to 50

plugins.hypothesis: Anchor-conditioned corroboration can retain useful evidence that rank-only objectives drop; the null control keeps the same anchors with zero support weights.
plugins.input_schema: shared query embedding, Top-50 embeddings/texts/metadata, and scorer values
plugins.output_schema: four ordered unique Top-5 records plus a support trace for the graph arm and explicit null-control identity
plugins.resource_estimate: four selector calls per question, 200 total

plugins.hypothesis: Paired frozen generation exposes whether evidence retention transfers to answer utility.
plugins.input_schema: question and one selector's ordered Top-5 context
plugins.output_schema: prediction, EM/F1, proxy evidence flags, and elapsed time

plugins.insertion_point: after all in-memory generations and evaluations
plugins.hypothesis: Complete per-question traces distinguish retrieval, selector, and generation strata.
plugins.input_schema: complete case records and runtime provenance

composition.merge_rule: One shared retrieval/scorer result is fanned out to QORE, Top-k, Support Graph, and support-disabled control; all returned contexts use the same frozen Generator.
interaction_ablations: QORE versus Top-k on identical candidate ranks
Support Graph versus the same-anchor zero-support null control
Support Graph versus Top-k selected-ID parity
answer-string proxy retention versus paired EM/F1
support trace components versus selected ranks

validation.baseline_equivalence: Candidate ids, texts, embeddings, ranks, and scorer scores are identical across all four arm inputs.
tests: validate-only does not load Wiki-DPR or Generator

reproducibility.dataset_identity: nq_open validation all 50 positions 3150-3199 within validation[3150:3200]
reproducibility.environment: Record resolved Generator identity, config and plan hashes, Python, git revision, selector allowlist, and timing.

fresh_screen.action_if_pass: eligible for independent full-data screen; no production change
fresh_screen.action_if_fail: close support-graph candidate without parameter rescue

limitations: This is an L0 fresh selector screen, not a population-level utility claim.
Answer-string-in-text flags are proxies and cannot replace gold passage annotation.
A fresh screen pass authorizes a separate full-data experiment only after user review; it does not authorize production replacement.

recovery_contract.discriminating_intermediate_measurement: Paired fresh-50 task EM/F1, support-versus-control deltas, selected evidence proxy retention, selected-ID parity, support trace, and cost under a frozen Top-50.
